info.name: HappyPaws API
info.description:
Comprehensive API testing suite for the HappyPaws platform. Covers all endpoints across Auth, Users, Rescues, Listings, Applications, Conversations, Pledges, Transports, Notifications, and Admin.

**Setup:**
1. Select the `HappyPaws - Local` environment.
2. Run `POST /auth/register` or `POST /auth/login` — the test script will auto-populate `accessToken`, `refreshToken`, and `userId`.
3. All subsequent requests use the Bearer token automatically via the collection-level auth.
